toegepas.voor: Lees laastens die name op die kaart binne jou provinsie.
toegepas.na: Lees laastens die name binne jou provinsie op die kaart.
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written, 'die kaart binne jou provinsie' reads as a map inside your province; moving 'op die kaart' to the end attaches 'binne jou provinsie' to the names.
toegepas.fout: 'die kaart binne jou provinsie' attaches the place phrase to the map instead of to the names, so the sentence can be read as a map inside your province.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Moving 'op die kaart' to the end ties 'binne jou provinsie' to the names, with the same words and the same instruction, and no protected wording is touched.
